title: MCP Protocol Compliance Rules
description: Minimum behavior required for Evolith MCP server transports and handlers.

rules.title: Initialize Request Must Return Capabilities
rules.description: The MCP server MUST respond to initialize with protocolVersion, capabilities, and serverInfo.
rules.validationQuery: Send JSON-RPC initialize request and validate response shape.

rules.title: Tools List Must Be Complete and Stable
rules.description: tools/list MUST expose every supported tool with name, description, and inputSchema.
rules.validationQuery: Call tools/list and validate each tool descriptor.

rules.title: Resources Must Preserve Core Traceability
rules.description: resources/read responses MUST identify the Core artifact or ruleset source behind the returned context.
rules.validationQuery: Read representative resources and verify source traceability metadata or content path.

rules.title: HTTP Transport Requires Explicit Authentication Mode
rules.description: When HTTP transport is enabled outside local development, an API key or equivalent authentication mode MUST be configured.
rules.validationQuery: Inspect MCP transport config for apiKey or local-only mode.

rules.title: MCP Calls Should Emit Metrics
rules.description: Tool calls SHOULD record latency, success, failure, and error class metrics.
rules.validationQuery: Call a tool and inspect MCP metrics output.
